strings.zh: 如果你身上有反覆發炎或變大的腫塊，別再嘗試擠它了 — 一次完整手術切除，從此根治。健保有給付。
strings.en: If you have a recurrently inflamed or enlarging lump, stop trying to squeeze it — one complete surgical excision is curative. The procedure is covered by Taiwan NHI.

strings.zh: 細菌進入 → 真正的細菌感染 / 化膿

strings.zh: 反覆刺激 → 囊袋變大 → 之後手術切除困難 + 切口更大
strings.en: Repeated trauma → cyst wall enlarges → harder to excise later, larger incision needed

strings.zh: 消炎後等 2-3 個月再做完整切除
strings.en: Wait 2–3 months after inflammation subsides, then perform complete excision

strings.zh: 反覆注射可能造成皮膚萎縮
strings.en: Repeated injections can cause skin atrophy

strings.en: Procedure codes: vary by size and location

strings.zh: 多發性粉瘤、特殊部位(陰囊、會陰、肛周)亦給付
strings.en: Multiple cysts and special sites (scrotum, perineum, perianal) are also covered

strings.zh: 單顆切除手術，可一次切除 1-3 顆
strings.en: Per-lesion excision; 1–3 cysts can be removed in one session

strings.zh: 毛根鞘囊腫包膜較完整，手術相對容易
strings.en: Trichilemmal cysts have a more intact capsule, making excision relatively easier

strings.zh: 術後傷口處理同其他部位
strings.en: Post-op wound care is the same as other sites

strings.zh: 不影響功能、不痛不癢的小粉瘤可觀察
strings.en: Small asymptomatic cysts that don't impair function can be observed

strings.zh: 影響外觀、性功能、反覆發炎建議切除
strings.en: Excision recommended if cosmetically concerning, affecting sexual function, or recurrently inflamed

strings.zh: 由皮膚科或泌尿科 / 一般外科評估
strings.en: Evaluated by dermatology, urology, or general surgery

strings.zh: 陰囊皮膚張力小、癒合快，但要避免感染
strings.en: Scrotal skin has low tension and heals quickly, but infection must be avoided

strings.zh: 消炎後 2-3 個月再做完整切除
